results: Startup registers one scroll/resize/visibility handler, observes root, and queues one RAF
Twenty scroll events plus resize notifications coalesce into the pending RAF
Initial motion settles, leaves no RAF, and reaches all four expected targets
Subsequent scroll restarts motion and settles with all layers at the +60px clamp
Scrolling farther beyond an unchanged clamp runs one RAF with zero transform writes
Hiding during motion cancels the pending RAF immediately
Hidden scroll, window resize, and ResizeObserver notifications queue no RAF and write no transforms
Becoming visible schedules exactly one restart RAF
Visible restart remeasures changed geometry and settles at current targets
Cleanup during motion cancels RAF, removes all listeners, and disconnects ResizeObserver
Events after cleanup cannot restart animation or write transforms
Ten start/cleanup cycles retain exactly one live handler per event and no old observers or RAFs
Starting while hidden installs lifecycle handlers but schedules no RAF
Cleanup of a hidden start also removes every handler and observer
method: Temporary Node harness using transpiled production scroll-motion.ts and controlled DOM, RAF, ResizeObserver and visibility events; not a native rendering or React integration test.
